data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, October 7, 2026: Crypto prices fade along with risk appetite
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $85,546.23 on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, down 0.3% compared with Tuesday's opening price. As of 7:17 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin moved lower to $83,771.28 Ethereum opened at $2,697.32, down 0.5% from Tuesday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved down this morning to $2,580.58 as of 7:17 a.m. ET.
